visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with an introductory montage of steaming miso soup bowls and rice balls served on wooden trays. (2) The scene transitions to the first restaurant, MISOJYU, showing its logo and a morning menu board outside. Close-up shots feature a breakfast set with a large bowl of vegetable-rich miso soup, a triangular onigiri topped with flakes, and a soft-boiled egg. The woman is seen lifting the bowl to drink, with warm, soft indoor lighting highlighting the food's steam. (3) The second restaurant, Naka Yoshi, is introduced through its menu title. The imagery focuses on grilled fish with lemon, fried chicken on skewers, and bowls of fluffy white rice. The woman is shown using chopsticks to eat a mouthful of rice, smiling slightly. The background shows traditional wooden panels typical of a Japanese diner. (4) The third restaurant, Zojirushi Shokudo, is presented, showing its blue fabric entrance curtain. The video highlights a premium set containing several small colorful side dishes in a wooden box, a bowl of rice, and slices of beef katsu with a rich sauce. The woman is seated at a table, being served rice by a staff member. (5) The final segment displays the brand's pink logo card with various social media handles and icons for interaction, set against a clean white background.
